author: The Stacks Project Authors

difficulty_reason: The lemma proves that the module of homomorphisms into a module of depth at least one or at least two inherits that depth bound, and the proof is a 14-line argument through a chosen presentation. It dualises a presentation of the first module into a short exact sequence whose middle term is a finite direct sum of copies of the second module, notes that submodules of modules of positive depth again have positive depth, and then uses the depth lemma for a short exact sequence to propagate the stronger bound from the outer terms to the kernel. The presentation and the exact sequence are displayed, and the two depth inputs are used at the specific places indicated.
